manager.nonNullCall: The caller output pointer is forwarded to virtual slot48(getInt) or50(getDouble). Each call locks/unlocks its own manager mutex; the sampler has no surrounding transaction across fields.

proxy.writeGates: 16AFC/16C2C exit if Binder transact returns nonzero;16B0C/16C3C exit if reply status is nonzero. The sole caller-output stores16B18/16C48 are reached only after both successes. Failure leaves the caller buffer unchanged. RELR entries plus vtable bytes bind the virtual slots; strings alone are not proof.
proxy.transportFailureReturn: The proxy initializes status800003E8 and returns it on a nonzero transact result; a nonzero remote reply status is returned directly. Neither failure writes an unavailable number to output.

newFindings.proofLimit: These are finite conditional source compositions, never injected or observed on the car. They require the later getter to take a no-write failure path. The saved good/error-free API rows do not prove that schedule occurred. The model proves caller-output lifetime and absence of an acceptance check, not the frequency or runtime reachability of a particular service failure. Scratch is explicitly initialized; this is defined stale/other-field reuse, not a claim of uninitialized memory.
